intro: Curgle Cranklehop has a new picture-taking device ready, the Super Snapper FX, and hands it to you to try out. The subject is Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands. With her snapshot in hand, you bring it and the device to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village. This follows The Borrower.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Have the first look at my new invention, friend. All you need to do is target whatever it is you'd like to take a picture of, and push the button.
What was that creature from the Hinterlands that you mentioned? Gammerita? Well, good luck finding her. I'm sure Daryn will be quite pleased with the snapshot you return to her.
In any case, here's the Super Snapper. Have fun!

clips.title: Progress
paras: So, you have finally returned, friend. And you've brought the contraption that Curgle built for me -- perfect.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well! Curgle's invention lived up to its expectations.
Don't get too excited, but do know that I am pleased with your work, friend.
Now, where did I leave that book...
